question: Identify the group of fiber crops which are produced on a large scale in India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jute and Cotton**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jute and cotton** are the main **fiber crops** produced on a large scale in India.
 
• Fibre crops are crops grown for their fibers, which are used for multiple purposes such as making ropes, paper, cloth, etc.
 
• As per the Food and Agriculture Organisation of the United Nations, **India is the world's largest producer of fibrous crops such as jute**.
 
• Jute and cotton are used extensively in various industries, particularly the textile industry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Tea and coffee**: These are both beverage crops produced in India, with tea being one of the most important.
 
• **Gram and pigeon peas**: These are examples of pulse crops grown in India and are important sources of protein.
 
• **Wheat and rice**: These are staple food crops that make up a large part of the Indian diet.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• By use, crops fall into six categories: **food crops, feed crops, fiber crops, oil crops, ornamental crops, and industrial crops**.

 
 

 Crop Type
 Description
 Examples
 
 
 
 

 Food Crops
 Grown for human consumption
 Wheat, corn, rice
 
 

 Feed Crops
 Grown as food for livestock
 Alfalfa, clover, certain grasses
 
 

 Fiber Crops
 Produce material for manufacturing purposes
 Cotton, flax, hemp
 
 

 Oil Crops
 Used for extracting plant oils
 Sunflowers, canola, olives
 
 

 Ornamental Crops
 Grown for aesthetic appeal in gardens and landscapes
 Roses, tulips, azaleas
 
 

 Industrial Crops
 Used in a variety of industrial purposes
 Sugar cane (for biofuel), rubber tree (for latex)
